problem: A verifier-only main advance triggered Production Source Snapshot and exact Netlify SHA readback, forcing a deployment even though no production runtime file had changed. The fallback deploy transport then failed with repeated 401 Unauthorized.
rootCause: Production delivery equated every site-shell verifier change with deployable website runtime. Runtime applicability was not derived separately from verification/control-plane applicability.

preventionRule: Require an exact Netlify production SHA only when deployable runtime changed; verifier-only main advances must validate the currently live ancestor with the new verifier and must prove that every intervening path is control-plane-only.
prevention: Production Source Snapshot ignores explicitly enumerated verifier-only files.
Production Release Readback derives deployment applicability from runtimeChangedPaths.
Canonical shell live readback may use a live ancestor only after git ancestry and all-delta control-plane proof.
Any runtime HTML, asset, Netlify function or shared Netlify runtime delta preserves exact deploy identity requirements.
Do not retry an unauthorized deploy transport for a non-deployment change.

evidence.failedTransport: Netlify exact-source upload returned 401 Unauthorized on all bounded retries

evaluation.expected: Verifier-only advances stay non-deployment and read existing live runtime safely; real runtime changes still require exact production deployment identity.
